title: Design Food Delivery App
description: Model restaurants, menus, orders, delivery tracking, and payments.

data.text: Design a food delivery app like Uber Eats or DoorDash. Customers browse restaurants, place orders, track delivery, and rate experiences.

data.title: Restaurant, Order, and Delivery
Geo queries
data.text: Use PostGIS or geohash to find nearby restaurants. A simple Haversine formula works for small datasets. For production, geohash prefix matching gives O(log N) nearby lookups.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Restaurant has a menu and location
Order links customer, restaurant, items, and status
Delivery tracks partner location and ETA
data.takeaway: Food delivery is a marketplace with orders and logistics. Restaurants are sellers. Orders are transactions. Delivery is real-time tracking.
